title: NFK Training Row
description: Single row of the NFK (Next-Frame Knowledge) training dataset. Java side `backend/.../NfkDataExportService` writes this format as CSV; Python side `research/nfk/data/contract_validator.py` validates it before training. CSV header line is fixed to: 'user_id,question_id,skill_id,response,timestamp'. Rows are validated against this schema before being written by the exporter and after being parsed by the trainer.

user_id.description: Platform user ID (alethicode.users.id). Always strictly positive — the backend SQL filter excludes user_id <= 0 to drop anonymous and system rows.

skill_id.description: Primary KC ID for the question. When ai_problem_kc_mapping has multiple KCs for one problem_id, the row with highest weight wins; ties are broken by ascending kc_id. The exporter joins via `DISTINCT ON (problem_id)` ORDER BY weight DESC, kc_id ASC.

response.description: Submission outcome encoding: 1 if submission.result = 0 (Accepted), else 0. All non-AC verdicts (WA / TLE / RE / CE / ...) collapse to 0.

timestamp.description: Submission creation time in canonical ISO-8601 UTC, exactly as produced by `java.time.Instant.toString()`. Examples: '2026-04-29T07:13:45Z', '2026-04-29T07:13:45.123Z', '2026-04-29T07:13:45.123456789Z'. Local-time formats (with space separator or trailing offset) are rejected to prevent timezone drift between Java exporter and Python trainer.
